notes.title: [HOTFIX – June 11th ]
notes.notes: [p]Greetings, Survivors.[/p][p] [/p][p]We’d like to share details regarding recent improvements and fixes made to enhance your gaming experience.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]1. Improved a rare issue that occurred during tram repairs.[/b][/h3][h3][b]2. Improved a character movement and monster animations under unstable 3. network conditions.[/b][/h3][h3][b]4. Improved an issue where some users were unable to join the game properly.[/b][/h3][h3][b]5. Fixed an issue where the microphone appeared as “NONE” and could not be selected in the settings menu.[/b][/h3][h3][b]6. Improved a rare issue where item purchases in the shop were not processed correctly.[/b][/h3][h3][b]7. Improved various functions related to network synchronization.[/b][/h3][p] [/p][p]Improved multiple issues that were causing inconvenience while using MIMESIS.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Users with different versions of the game will not be able to play together.[/b][/h3][h3][b]please make sure to get the update and restart the game.[/b][/h3][h3][/h3][p]If the update does not proceed automatically or the button remains inactive, please exit the Steam client completely and reconnect to initiate the update.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]
